title: Tanner McKee: I'm ready to make the most of "huge opportunity"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tanner McKee: I'm ready to make the most of "huge opportunity"
sources.description: Tanner McKee fell to No. 3 on the depth chart ahead of Week 1 this season, but he worked his way back to the No. 2 job in time to be the next man up when the Eagles made a surprising announcement on Thursday.
